definitions.explanation: The way a person behaves or carries themselves, especially in their demeanor toward others; one's stance or position on a matter.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}は{失礼|しつれい}だった。
{態度|たいど}を{改|あらた}めてください。
{政府|せいふ}は{明確|めいかく}な{態度|たいど}を{示|しめ}すべきだ。
examples.english: The government should show a clear stance.
examples.notes: 態度 = stance/position on an issue

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {態度|たいど}を{取|と}る (to take an attitude/stance)
- {態度|たいど}を{示|しめ}す (to show one's attitude/position)
- {態度|たいど}を{変|か}える / {改|あらた}める (to change one's attitude)
- {態度|たいど}が{悪|わる}い (to have a bad attitude)
- {態度|たいど}がでかい (to be arrogant, to have a big attitude)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どっちつかずの{態度|たいど} (ambivalent attitude, sitting on the fence)
- {曖昧|あいまい}な{態度|たいど} (vague/noncommittal attitude)
- {強硬|きょうこう}な{態度|たいど} (tough stance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {態度|たいど}: General attitude, manner, stance
- {姿勢|しせい}: Posture; also attitude (more formal)
